evidence.t: Burn from 2018 (fire R91655), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SE facing slope, 21 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 90 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 78 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.27242, -130.59523, pull off on Hwy 51 (Telegraph Creek Rd) (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 31 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,337 m, about 757 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 200 m N of the spot at 1,155 m (58.49089, -130.93278). Water: unnamed wetland 280 m S (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-22, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-12, closures 2026-10-16.
